title: ACT-006 · Overshoot the ledge
situation: Run, jump too far, catch an edge, hang and pull up.
success_observation: Hands attach at the ledge; body weight hangs below grip; recovery is continuous.

beats.beat: over the top of the arc
right knee comes up the wall, hips back
left knee comes up the wall

not_checked: crossed feet and planted foot turned > 65 deg from the hips: need a depth axis; this rig is a 2D profile
arm stretch > 1.12: cardboard pieces never stretch, so any reach beyond the arm is a missed contact instead
forearms within 3 cm of each other: near and far arms are on different card layers
hand inside an unintended torso of another performer: only torsos and heads are tested against each other
pose continuity beyond the solver (the display list has no pops by construction; replacement swaps are intended)
event synchronization other than contact frames; root path against obstacles other than solid props
ledger: Stand-in cardboard dummy pieces drawn by build_dummy.py; the man's cut pieces replace them by id.
The performance is authored in the challenge script (keys and motion generators); nothing is captured or retargeted.
